CR20AP is a waterproof, dustproof collaborative robot in Dobot's CRA-IP68 series, rated IP68 for harsh industrial environments. It carries a 20 kg maximum payload over a 1700 mm working radius.

NB80 is a heavy-payload industrial robot arm from ROKAE. The NB80-80/2.2 configuration carries an 80 kg payload over a 2200 mm reach, weighs about 635 kg, has 6 degrees of freedom with IP65 protection (IP67 at the wrist), AC servo drive and ±0.06 mm repeatability.

NB220 is ROKAE's largest industrial robot arm series. The NB220R-150/3.1 configuration carries a 150 kg payload over a 3100 mm reach, weighs about 1672 kg, has 6 degrees of freedom with IP65 protection (IP67 at the wrist), AC servo drive and ±0.08 mm repeatability.

xMate ZR is a force-controlled collaborative robot arm from ROKAE. The ZR6-6/0.98C configuration carries a 6 kg payload over a 980 mm reach, weighs about 20 kg including its built-in control cabinet, with ±0.05 mm repeatability, IP54 protection, 6-axis force/torque sensing at the tool flange and adjustable Cartesian stiffness for compliant manipulation.

Rizon 10 is the higher-payload model in Flexiv's Rizon series of force-controlled adaptive robot arms. It has 7 degrees of freedom, a 10 kg payload, 984 mm reach, weighs 39 kg, and offers IP65 protection, ±0.05 mm pose repeatability (ISO 9283) and 0.1 N force-sensing accuracy at the end effector.

A5 is a modular robotic arm from ARX Robotics, officially listed on the company's product release timeline with an unveiling date of April 15, 2026, alongside its other research and data-collection robots such as X5, X7, LIFT and LIFT 2.

MagicArm R1 is a bionic force-controlled desktop robotic arm from MagicLab for embodied-AI research and secondary development. It has 6 degrees of freedom, a 700 mm reach, a 180-degree forearm bend, weighs 5.5 kg, carries a 4 kg payload, and offers real-time per-joint torque sensing with +/-0.1 mm repeatability and 0.4 s vibration settling, with native support for grippers, dexterous hands and suction-cup end effectors.

The HCR-12A is a 12 kg-payload collaborative robot arm from Hanwha Robotics, part of its HCR cobot lineup. It has a 1,300 mm reach, 6 degrees of freedom and weighs about 53 kg, aimed at heavy-load tasks in automotive, metal processing and logistics.

CS630 is a 30 kg-payload collaborative robot arm in Elite Robots' CS series, with a 1300 mm working radius, +/-0.05 mm repeatability and 625 W typical power consumption, aimed at heavier pick-and-place, palletizing and material-handling tasks.

OMY is a 6-DOF robotic manipulator arm in ROBOTIS's open Physical AI lineup, built for ROS 2-based imitation-learning and intelligent-automation research, positioned in ROBOTIS's product menu alongside the simpler OMX arm and the full-body AI Worker humanoid.

myArm 300 Pi 2023 is a desktop robot arm from Elephant Robotics powered by a Raspberry Pi 4B running the company's customized Ubuntu Mate 20.04 image, giving it a PC-like experience without an external computer. It is aimed at robotics education, control algorithm development and research, sold alongside Elephant Robotics' myCobot and myArm lines. Elephant publishes no global price; regional prices and bundles differ.

COBOTTA PRO 900 is a compact collaborative robot arm from Denso Wave with a 6 kg payload and 1,066 mm maximum reach, repeatability of ±0.03 mm, and a maximum TCP speed of 2,500 mm/s outside collaborative mode. It is the smaller of the two-model COBOTTA PRO line alongside the COBOTTA PRO 1300.

The VLA-4025 is a 6-axis industrial robot arm from Denso Wave's VL series, built for palletizing, packaging and material handling. It carries a 40 kg payload with a 2,503 mm maximum reach, ±0.06 mm repeatability, and IP65/IP67 wrist protection for harsh environments.

The VLA-6022 is the higher-payload model in Denso Wave's VL series of 6-axis industrial robots, rated for 60 kg payload with a 2,257 mm maximum reach, ±0.06 mm repeatability and IP65/IP67 protection, used for palletizing and material handling.

The LPH040A1 is a compact 4-axis SCARA robot from Denso Wave with a 3 kg payload, 400 mm reach, and positioning repeatability of ±0.02 mm, aimed at entry-level electronics assembly and pick-and-place automation.

Toala is a dual-arm research robot from Tokyo Robotics that estimates joint torque with a disturbance observer instead of dedicated torque sensors, enabling impedance control for automation and verification research.
Torobo Arm is a research robotic arm from Tokyo Robotics fitted with joint torque sensors on every axis and simulator integration, built for force- and impedance-control research.
Torobo Arm Mini is a compact collaborative research arm from Tokyo Robotics, a smaller sibling of Torobo Arm emphasizing safety and ease of use alongside force- and impedance-control capability.
HCR-32 is a heavy-payload collaborative robot arm in Hanwha Robotics' HCR series, built for industrial automation tasks requiring a 32 kg payload and 1820 mm reach.
HCR-14 is a mid-payload collaborative robot arm from Hanwha Robotics' HCR series, offering a 14 kg payload and 1420 mm reach for industrial automation.
HCR-10L is a long-reach collaborative robot arm in Hanwha Robotics' HCR series, carrying a 10 kg payload over a 1800 mm reach for industrial automation tasks.
HCR-5A is a compact collaborative robot arm from Hanwha Robotics' HCR series, designed for a 5 kg payload and 915 mm reach in industrial automation.
HCR-3A is Hanwha Robotics' smallest HCR-series collaborative robot arm, built for light-duty tasks with a 3 kg payload and 630 mm reach.
HCR-5W is a lightweight collaborative robot arm in Hanwha Robotics' HCR series, offering a 4.5 kg payload and 625 mm reach for compact automation cells.
HH4 is an industrial handling robot arm from HD Hyundai Robotics used in flat-panel-display (FPD) manufacturing processes, offering a 4 kg payload and 581 mm reach with the Hi5a-S00 controller.

D-Bot is a line of six-axis collaborative robot arms from Taiwan's Delta Electronics, manufactured in Germany, with payload capacities from 6 kg to 30 kg and repeatability up to +/-0.02 mm. Select models carry IP66 protection and PL d / SIL 3 safety certification for automotive, electronics, food and pharmaceutical applications.

DRVA8LN is a six-axis articulated industrial robot arm from Delta Electronics of Taiwan with a maximum payload of 25 kg and a working radius of 1,800 mm, aimed at heavy-duty handling and assembly applications.

The TM25S is a heavy-payload cobot in Techman Robot's TM AI Cobot S Series, built with a 25 kg payload and a 1902 mm reach plus a built-in force-torque sensor for pick-and-place, machine tending, packaging and palletizing work. Techman Robot is a Taiwan-based cobot maker and Quanta Computer subsidiary.

The TM30S is the top of Techman Robot's TM AI Cobot S Series, rated for a 30 kg payload (expandable to 35 kg for palletizing) with a 1702 mm reach, an integrated force-torque sensor and TUV-certified safety for heavy-duty push stacking, machine-tool tending and automotive assembly.

The TM20S is a heavy-duty cobot in Techman Robot's TM AI Cobot S Series with a 20 kg payload and 1300 mm working radius, aimed at machine tending, material handling, case packing and heavy-part pick-and-place in logistics and automotive lines.

The TM16 is a higher-payload cobot in Techman Robot's standard TM AI Cobot series, rated for 16 kg payload with 917 mm reach, built for machine tending, material handling and packaging with Techman's built-in vision system.

CyRo is a stationary dual-arm, 6-axis-per-arm industrial robot from Bengaluru-based CynLr, built on the company's Object Intelligence (OI) software stack so it can pick and manipulate unfamiliar, transparent or reflective objects without prior training, using its CLX vision system and integrated force-torque sensing. It targets high-speed kitting, sorting and assembly and was publicly demonstrated from 2024, including a 2026 showcase tied to Audi manufacturing lines.

Cynoid 7A is CynLr's mobile dual-arm robot, pairing two 7-axis arms on a high-mobility base with the company's Object Intelligence vision and force-torque sensing stack so it can travel between workstations and perform tactile assembly tasks such as snap-fitting without pre-programming. It is aimed at unstructured automotive and electronics assembly lines.

Mantroid is an announced three-wheeled, height-adjustable robotic system from CynLr aimed at high-payload dexterous manipulation and narrow-space access for logistics and retrieval tasks at varied heights. It is listed by CynLr as 'coming soon' and not yet shipping.
Collaborative robot arm in AUBO Robotics' industrial iS series, sold alongside Ex (explosion-proof), Pro and SE variants spanning payload classes from iS3 to iS35.
Collaborative robot arm in AUBO Robotics' G series, offered alongside the higher-payload AUBO-G40 for industrial automation tasks.
Industrial collaborative robot arm in JAKA Robotics' new A series, sold in multiple payload configurations (A5, A12, A12L, A20) alongside the company's existing Zu and MiniCobo cobot lines.

HDT1000-33 is HD Hyundai Robotics first independently developed 1-ton-payload heavy-duty industrial robot, a 6-axis articulated arm first delivered on 18 Nov 2026 to Korea R&D Co. in Ansan for construction-machinery engine production, with a 3.3 m work radius and positioning accuracy within 0.1 mm.

M0617 is a collaborative robot arm in Doosan Robotics M-series, rated for a 6 kg payload with a 1,700 mm working radius and +/-0.1 mm repeatability; it is documented in Doosan case studies for machine-tool tending automation (e.g. at Sinsung Precision), sharing its 6 kg payload class with the shorter-reach M0609 (900 mm radius).

S20 is ROBOSTAR's largest SCARA robot in its 2024 S-series, handling up to 20 kg over 800 or 1000 mm arm lengths at up to 11,250 mm/s with +/-0.025 mm repeatability, for assembly, transfer, inspection and screw-fastening tasks.

S10 is a mid-size SCARA robot in ROBOSTAR's 2024 S-series, rated for 5 kg (10 kg max) payload across 600-800 mm arm lengths with +/-0.015 mm repeatability, used for component assembly, transfer and inspection.
S05 is the compact model in ROBOSTAR's 2024 S-series of SCARA robots, rated for 2 kg (5 kg max) payload across 400-600 mm arm lengths with +/-0.015 mm repeatability and a 0.29 s cycle time.
RPA110 is a large-standard SCARA robot from ROBOSTAR built with a rigid cast body and precision reducers, offering a 20 kg payload across arm lengths up to 1100 mm with +/-0.04 mm repeatability.

A12 is a 6-axis vertical multi-joint robot in ROBOSTAR's 2024 A-series, carrying 12 kg over a 1452 mm reach with +/-0.04 mm repeatability, used for inspection, welding, bonding, painting, assembly and labeling.
RPK-080 is ROBOSTAR's parallel (delta) robot for high-speed pick-and-place work, built for simultaneous multi-part handling with integrated machine-vision guidance.

RA610 is a six-axis articulated industrial robot arm made by Taiwan's HIWIN Technologies, available in five arm lengths from 1151 to 1869 mm with rated payloads of 7-30 kg (depending on arm length) and repeatability of ±0.05-0.06 mm. It is an IP54-rated (IP65 wrist) machine-tending and material-handling arm sold alongside HIWIN's SCARA and welding robot lines.

RS410 is a SCARA (horizontal articulated) robot made by Taiwan's HIWIN Technologies for high-speed planar pick-and-place and assembly work in electronics and general manufacturing, rated for 5 kg (10 kg max) payload with 600-800 mm reach and +/-0.02-0.025 mm repeatability.

RS405 is a compact SCARA robot from Taiwan's HIWIN Technologies with a 2 kg rated / 5 kg max payload and 400-500 mm reach, repeatability of +/-0.01 to 0.02 mm, aimed at shorter-reach, lighter assembly, sorting and dispensing tasks than the larger RS410.

RA610 Welding Robot (RA610-1355-GC) is a welding-specific configuration of HIWIN Technologies' six-axis RA610 arm, built with a fixed 1355 mm reach, 12 kg rated payload (14 kg max) and +/-0.05 mm repeatability, and support for most welding power-source controls on the market.

JAKA S5 is a force-controlled collaborative robot arm from China's JAKA Robotics with 6 degrees of freedom, a 5 kg payload and 954 mm reach. It has a built-in multi-axis force/torque sensor for force-sensing drag-teaching and singularity protection, and is IP65 rated.

JAKA Mini2 is a compact 6-axis collaborative robot arm from China's JAKA Robotics, designed for lightweight, high-cycle-rate work in narrow installation spaces. It has a 2 kg payload, 580 mm reach, 1 m/s typical tool-end speed and ±0.05 mm repeat accuracy, and can be taught via a mobile phone/tablet app.

TX2-60 is a mid-size six-axis articulated robot in Swiss manufacturer Staubli's TX2 family, positioned between the TX2-40 and TX2-90, with a 670-920 mm reach and 3.7-4.5 kg payload depending on configuration. It uses the CS9 controller for fast, precise handling, assembly and inspection tasks.

TCB605 is a 6-axis collaborative robot arm in TLIBOT's Standard Version line, rated for 5 kg payload (8 kg maximum) with a 653 mm working radius, ±0.03 mm repeatability and 220 W average power at DC48V. Made by Sichuan TLIBOT Co., Ltd. (FDROBOT), it is also sold as the TCB605F/VF force-control and TCB605V/VF vision-enabled variants with six-dimensional force sensing or an integrated camera.

TCB705 is the 7-axis counterpart to TLIBOT's TCB605 in the Standard Version line, sharing its 5 kg rated/8 kg maximum payload and 653 mm working radius but adding a seventh joint and weighing 7.5 kg. Made by Sichuan TLIBOT Co., Ltd. (FDROBOT), it is also available as the TCB705F/VF force-control and TCB705V/VF vision-enabled variants.

TCB610 is a 6-axis collaborative robot arm in TLIBOT's Standard Version line, rated for 10 kg payload (14 kg maximum) with a 761.5 mm working radius and ±0.03 mm repeatability. Made by Sichuan TLIBOT Co., Ltd. (FDROBOT), it is also offered as the TCB610F force-control and TCB610V/VF vision-enabled variants.

TCB710 is the 7-axis counterpart to TCB610 in TLIBOT's Standard Version line, sharing its 10 kg rated/14 kg maximum payload and 761.5 mm working radius while adding a seventh joint and weighing 11 kg. Made by Sichuan TLIBOT Co., Ltd. (FDROBOT), it is also available as the TCB710F force-control and TCB710V/VF vision-enabled variants.

TCB605LV is the long-reach, vision-enabled variant of TLIBOT's TCB605 cobot, extending maximum working radius to 1161.5 mm while keeping the 5 kg rated/7 kg maximum payload of the Extended Version line. Made by Sichuan TLIBOT Co., Ltd. (FDROBOT), it is also sold as the TCB605L without the integrated vision module, which weighs 12.2 kg versus 12.4 kg for the LV version.

TCB705LV is the 7-axis, long-reach, vision-enabled variant of TLIBOT's TCB705 cobot, extending maximum working radius to 1161.5 mm while keeping the 5 kg rated/7 kg maximum payload of the Extended Version line. Made by Sichuan TLIBOT Co., Ltd. (FDROBOT), it is also sold as the TCB705L without the integrated vision module, which weighs 13 kg versus 13.2 kg for the LV version.

TCE605 is a 6-axis lightweight collaborative robot arm in TLIBOT's TCE 'Youth Edition' (青春版) series, launched in September 2026 at 17,880 CNY. It weighs 6.8 kg, carries 5 kg rated / 8 kg maximum payload over a 653 mm working radius with ±0.05 mm repeatability, uses harmonic-drive joints with dual encoders and brakes on every joint, runs on DC48V at under 100 W average power, and supports ROS and an open API for mounting on composite robots, quadrupeds and drones.

The RBK-100 "Robotics-in-a-Box" is a Physical AI development kit from ASRock Industrial, built with Intel, combining an Intel Core Ultra X7-powered NUC BOX-358H edge computer, an RGB-D perception camera, and a 6-DOF leader-and-follower robotic arm set for demonstration-driven manipulation research. It ships with preinstalled AiRoboStarter software covering teleoperation, demonstration recording, dataset review, AI model training and robot-skill execution (supporting ACT and Pi0.5 workflows), and the 64GB Advanced configuration adds an agentic workflow linking voice interaction and visual perception to trained robot skills. Aimed at researchers, educators and developers; ASRock Industrial labels the announced specification preliminary and subject to change.

The Ti5robot A6 (Chinese: 钛极-A6) is a dual-arm force-controlled system with two 7-DoF arms that works standalone or as the arm module of a humanoid robot, with torque sensors integrated in every joint, a cross-offset wrist, 6 kg rated payload per arm (12 kg for both arms) and 691 mm reach. Its joints reach up to 180°/s and use CAN communication on a 48 V supply; Ti5 labels these specifications as preliminary while the product is still in development. Ti5 debuted it at WAIC 2026 in Shanghai in July 2026, and it won a CIIF Award at the China International Industry Fair in October 2026.

Touch R1 is a 6-DoF desktop robotic arm from Shenzhen-based Lumos Robotics, designed to pair with the company's FastUMI Pro data-collection system as a real-hardware validation platform for imitation learning, reinforcement learning and VLA research. The maker lists a 1.5 kg payload, up to 657 mm reach, ±0.1 mm repeatability, integrated servo joints, a standard gripper with 130 N rated grip force, DC 24 V supply, upright/inverted/side mounting, CAN control with drag teaching, offline trajectory playback and API access, and ROS/ROS2 SDK support. It has been listed on the Lumos website since at least August 2026, with purchase by inquiry.
